## SurveyJS

Installed in this project: `survey-core@3.1.0`, `survey-creator-core@3.1.0`, `survey-creator-react@3.1.0`, `survey-react-ui@3.1.0`. UI framework: **react**.

The SurveyJS agent skills are installed in `.github/skills`. Read the skill that matches the task before writing or changing SurveyJS code — they carry the current v3 API and the mistakes to check generated code against:

- [`surveyjs-brand-styling`](skills/surveyjs-brand-styling/SKILL.md) — Style a SurveyJS application so it matches a custom app design, design system, or brandbook
- [`surveyjs-creator-customization`](skills/surveyjs-creator-customization/SKILL.md) — Embed and customize SurveyJS Survey Creator (the drag-and-drop form builder) in React, Angular, Vue, or vanilla JS
- [`surveyjs-form-json`](skills/surveyjs-form-json/SKILL.md) — Author, edit, or debug SurveyJS survey/form JSON
- [`surveyjs-integration`](skills/surveyjs-integration/SKILL.md) — Integrate the SurveyJS Form Library into React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, vanilla JS, or jQuery apps
- [`surveyjs-linter`](skills/surveyjs-linter/SKILL.md) — Statically analyze SurveyJS survey JSON for logic defects with the SurveyJS linter

Everything between the `surveyjs:start` and `surveyjs:end` markers is regenerated by `surveyjs-cli 0.2.0` (`npx surveyjs-cli@latest init-agents`). Put your own notes outside the markers.
<!-- surveyjs:end -->

## Documentation

On every change to this project, update `README.md` and any other affected documentation so they stay consistent with the code. This includes:

- New, removed, or renamed features and use cases
- Changes to the tech stack, dependencies, scripts, ports, or environment variables
- Changes to the project structure (new/moved folders, repositories, schemas, pages)
- Changes to persistence, API endpoints, authentication, or seed/demo data
- Changes to how SurveyJS forms are integrated, themed, or edited

Never leave documentation describing behavior that no longer exists.

## Testing

Every newly implemented functionality must ship with tests in the same change:

- **Unit tests** (Vitest, `tests/unit/`) for new server logic (`server/db.ts`, `server/app.ts` API endpoints), repository/mapping logic (`src/repositories/`), and new or modified SurveyJS schemas (they must pass the schema lint gate in `tests/unit/schemas.test.ts`). Use `createDb(':memory:')` for DB tests.
- **E2E tests** (Playwright, `tests/e2e/`) for new user-facing flows (pages, modals, forms, role-based behavior). Reset state via `POST /api/admin/reset` in `beforeEach`; use `tests/e2e/auth-helpers.ts` to bypass login where the flow under test is not authentication itself.
- Run `npm run test:unit` and `npm run test:e2e` (plus `npm run lint`) and make them pass before considering the change complete.
